svg.desc: Stacked bars of bytes per parameter. fp32 AdamW: 4 for weights, 4 for gradients, 8 for the two Adam moments, 16 in total. PyTorch autocast keeps the same fp32 state and adds a 2-byte fp16 copy, 18 in total. The ZeRO accounting uses fp16 weights and gradients plus 12 bytes of fp32 master weights and moments, 16 in total. Activations come on top and often dominate.
